message.content: Li Hua has planned to celebrate the Chinese Lunar New Year at her place on January 18th. This information is mentioned in the conversation that took place at 09:30 on January 13th, 2026, where she extended an invitation to Wolfgang Schultz to join her for the celebration. The festive atmosphere will include traditional dishes, decorations, and a variety of food and drinks, with dumplings being a particular highlight. Wolfgang expressed his enthusiasm for attending and enjoying the celebration with Li Hua.
